findings.summary: AssetIdempotencyConflictException was a reachable public typed owner exception absent from the previous focused mapping sample; it requires an explicit 409 PLATFORM_COMMON_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT mapping.
Completeness is a 75-type source denominator cross every global and controller-local handler surface, with typed inheritance closure; no source type is NOT_REACHABLE or UNMAPPED after the repair.
A generic RuntimeException, Exception, or Throwable handler would hide denominator drift and must fail closed rather than produce a typed success.
